statement: The IQ2_XXS_SSD_PREFILL_MM knob is NOT on the q4/q8 path. Its candidate gate at ds4_metal.m:50599-50600 at ds4-pr952 77a054e1 requires `gate_type == DS4_METAL_TENSOR_IQ2_XXS && down_type == DS4_METAL_TENSOR_Q2_K`, and the surrounding candidate also requires `g_ssd_streaming_mode` and `n_expert == 6`. The q4/q8 decode path uses different gate/down tensor types, so the IQ2 knob cannot fire there. The knob is value-parsed via ds4_gpu_env_bool (ds4_metal.m:50582 at ds4-pr952 77a054e1), and its REQUIRE spelling fails closed at ds4_metal.m:50658-50663 at ds4-pr952 77a054e1 with 'ds4: required Metal IQ2_XXS SSD grouped address-MM path was not selected tokens=%u gate=%u down=%u'.

claims.statement: The IQ2 grouped-MM candidate is gated on `gate_type == DS4_METAL_TENSOR_IQ2_XXS && down_type == DS4_METAL_TENSOR_Q2_K` at ds4_metal.m:50599-50600 at ds4-pr952 77a054e1, so it cannot fire on the q4/q8 path. The IQ2_XXS/Q2_K pairing recurs across the MoE prefill path (lines 47842, 47859, 48148, 48214, 50599, 50732, 50818, 50842, 50867), all on the IQ2 SSD prefill path, none on q4/q8 decode.
